messages:
Ari (CSM): Quick dry-run for the Meridian QBR tomorrow 9AM PT — can people confirm slide owners? Also renewal signal flagged: migration lag + support SLA hits. Need exec talking points. Slides in this thread:

Priya (AM): I can own exec ask + renewal health slide. I'll summarize usage trends and the migration risk.

Tom H. (Solutions): I'll do the onboarding status slide and run the demo. Need a short script for the demo. Who has the updated dataset? :raised_hand:

Marta (Enablement): I have enablement notes; will add enablement gaps and next steps. Uploading a slide in drive — link: https://drive.redwood.com/meridian/qbr-dryrun

Jules (CS Ops): Can we tighten the renewal language? suggest 'renewal at risk' vs 'high risk' — legal wants avoid absolutes. Also propose mitigations table.

Jules (CS Ops): ```
Slides:
1) Exec summary (Priya)
2) Health metrics & signals (Ari)
3) Onboarding progress + blockers (Tom)
4) Enablement plan + resources (Marta)
5) Mitigation & timeline (Jules)
6) Ask & next steps (Priya)
```

Ari (CSM): Perfect. Two asks: (1) include 4 bullet talking points for exec (30s each), (2) list of measurable health KPIs (err rate, time-to-first-response, migration percent). I'll draft and push by EOD.

Priya (AM): I'll draft exec bullets. Also need renewal contact names for exec readout — @Jules please ping legal for approved phrasing. :eyes: 

Tom H. (Solutions): Dataset is with eng-ops; @Marta can you confirm demo creds? If not, fallback demo: simulated ingestion.

Marta (Enablement): Confirmed. Demo creds are in LastPass folder 'Meridian QBR' — I'll paste a sanitized snippet in the slide notes. Also scheduled enablement recap with customer on Wed.

Jules (CS Ops): Action items:
- Priya: Exec bullets + final slide deck by 2026-04-01 EOD
- Ari: KPI section + risk scoring by 2026-03-30 noon
- Tom H.: Demo script + slides by 2026-03-30 5pm
- Marta: Enablement notes + LastPass creds by 2026-03-29 end
- Jules: Mitigation plan wording + legal sign-off by 2026-03-31

Priya (AM): :thumbsup: adding calendar invite for the 9AM PT dry-run. Invite sent.

OpsBot: Reminder set: dry-run 2026-04-02 16:00 UTC; 30m reminder 15m before.

Ari (CSM): Thanks all. Quick follow-up: capture customer feedback theme 'slow migration visibility' to include in post-QBR action tracker. I'll create jira: RDW-4321 and link in deck.
